greeting.speaker: npc
greeting.text: You have the look of someone who is not from the valley. Good. The locals have stopped listening to me.

pitch.speaker: npc
pitch.text: Something has been taking lambs from the high pasture. Not a wolf. Wolves leave a mess. Whatever this is leaves nothing at all. Find it, and there is coin in it for you.

haggle.speaker: npc
haggle.text: Forty silver, and the flock's gratitude. That is what a shepherd has to give.

choices.text: Not for forty. Find someone else.

accept.speaker: npc
accept.text: Then it is yours. Follow the stone wall up past the split oak. Take this — it was my father's, and it has seen worse nights than you will.

decline.speaker: npc
decline.text: Then the lambs keep going. Do not pretend you did not hear it.
